## Answer

`--max-results N` counts only four event types: `match`, `occurrence`, `file` and `count` (src/batch.zig:77-83; GUIA.md:779-780).

Context lines do **not** count. `context` and `passthru` merely accompany matches; the unit test feeds match+context+match+match with `--max-results 1` and expects returned=1, omitted=2 (src/batch.zig:568-579). Control events (`query_end`, `summary`) also never count (src/batch.zig:15-16), nor does `provenance`, though it still weighs on `--max-output-tokens` (GUIA.md:838-840).

In compact mode (`zgrep/1c`), rows tagged `c` (context) and `p` (passthru) don't count; `m`, `o`, `l`/`L`, `#`/`#m` do (src/batch.zig:269; src/out_json.zig:235-240, 316, 333).

The budget applies across the whole call, not per query (src/batch.zig:325-331; GUIA.md:780). Truncation doesn't stop the scan: dropped results are counted in `omitted` (src/batch.zig:333-339; GUIA.md:786-788). A budget requires `--json` (src/main.zig:1773-1776).
